cases.text: I folded the receipt and put it beside the apples. The cashier gave me my change.
Someone was testing the locked door from outside. I held my breath, waiting for the handle to turn again.
The rescue boat had brought everyone ashore. With the danger over, we sat under blankets and drank warm tea.
The guard's footsteps stopped outside my hiding place. A thin beam of light slid under the door.
On stage, the actor raised a rubber knife. During the break, the crew laughed and checked the harmless prop.
The cable above the lift was fraying. We stood still, listening for the next strand to snap.
